compute: Apple Core ML only; FP16 weights/compute, FP32 logits; no custom layers; no third-party execution backend

inputs.name: context_ids
dimension_meanings: last up to32 committed-left-context Unicode code points; left-aligned, right-pad0

inputs.name: pinyin_ids
dimension_meanings: one raw-input-derived legal syllable path; left-aligned, right-pad0
inputs.values: syllable IDs2..410; PAD0, unknown1 is never emitted by parser

outputs.name: character_logits
outputs.semantics: unnormalized source-model character logits; larger is better, not a correctness probability; padded target rows are ignored

batch_adapter.CoreML: one [1,...] prediction per path, up to8 calls; all paths preserved and merged with unchanged scores
batch_adapter.reason: fixed memory-bounded Apple input shape; path batch has no cross-example operation

vocabulary.Unicode: output Chinese vocabulary is single BMP scalar per non-special character; output alignment uses one UTF16 unit per generated character

normalization.pinyin: Unicode NFC then lowercase; accept only ASCII a-z (including v), ASCII apostrophe and space; no strip, no ü-to-v conversion, no tone-number removal
normalization.context: no normalization; last32 Unicode scalar/code points, unknown chars map to1; actual committed left text only
normalization.original_position_mapping: Swift NFC/lowercase conversion records original UTF8 and UTF16 spans for every normalized unit; accepted non-ASCII NFC edge positions map to original spans, unlike legacy Python ASCII-only offset assumption

parser.separators: apostrophe and ASCII space advance input without creating syllables
parser.boundary_source: actual raw input only; no answer-provided syllable boundaries

encoder.padding: right zero-padding with int32 validity masks

decoder.legal_character_table: binary: bool legal_readings[512,8192] represented as ascending character-ID lists
decoder.phrase_constraints: greedy longest matching phrase2..24 chars; syllable IDs must equal stored phrase reading; else require stored single-character default; checked after full path beam
decoder.sort: stable descending score across all parser paths
decoder.dedup: first candidate per exact text after global stable sort

candidate.stable_id: lowercase16hex FNV1a64(UTF8(original_raw + NUL + text + NUL + space_joined_reading + NUL + decimal_consumed_raw_UTF8_end)), seed14695981039346656037, multiplier1099511628211, uint64 wrap
candidate.id_collision_policy: matches V19 ID convention; identify selections within their result/inputVersion
candidate.recommended_id: first returned candidate ID, or nil
candidate.candidate_order: final SDK order; host App must not re-sort for the V19 trial
candidate.consumed_ranges: half-open [start,end), relative to ORIGINAL raw input; both UTF8 bytes and UTF16 code units provided
candidate.full_candidate: fullConsumption=true, consumed full original input including separators, remainingPinyin empty
candidate.alignment: generated-character UTF16 span + original raw UTF8/UTF16 syllable span + normalized UTF8 span + syllable text
candidate.partial_selection: select(prefixCharacterCount:) derives an aligned prefix of an already-returned full candidate, consumes through last selected syllable end, returns exact original suffix; not an extra decoder candidate
candidate.partial_generation: not present in original V19 B; no injected prefix candidates or unfinished-tail completion

decision.calibration: none in V19; no scale, bias, acceptance head or threshold to apply
decision.fallback: no legal complete path / no surviving candidate -> empty list and structured reason, retain composition; model/resource errors throw, do not substitute another engine

lifecycle.reuse: one prepared actor/model per keyboard process
lifecycle.request_version: UInt64 monotonic per composition/context update; older results return nil or are rejected at selection
lifecycle.cancel: cancelPending/resetComposition mark old generations obsolete; synchronous CoreML call already executing completes, results are discarded
lifecycle.release: releaseResources cancels and releases after any in-flight native call safely exits
lifecycle.compute_units_change: release and prepare explicitly when configuration changes, never reload for each key

resources.reading_rules_version: locked matching_resources_1793340328913539900; reachable phrase rules packed without score/search changes

unsupported: automatic completion of unfinished syllable tails
